purpose: minimum-scan capability-first onboarding without fake installation success
must_not_assume: local filesystem access from a web chat
native_requires: verified lifecycle hook firing when hooks are claimed
verified effect/result receipt when effects are claimed
candidate_status_suffix: _CANDIDATE means discovery only and must never be rendered as final installation success
failure_law: missing or unverified capability lowers the status; never synthesize success
structured_detector_scope: local read-only capability snapshot only; no network, provider credentials, hook execution, durable state mutation or effect execution
